📢 𝗔𝗻 𝗛𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝘂𝗻𝘁 📢

Hi Freshers 👋

You may have noticed fewer job posts from us last month. Here's the honest reason 👇

📉 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗲𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗹𝘆. Entry-level openings in IT are down nearly 𝟰𝟰% 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘁 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿 — due to AI adoption and cautious hiring by big IT companies.

⚠️ This is NOT because we stopped searching. We check openings every single day. When companies post less, there is simply less to share.
